create_mujoco_env: create a MuJoCo gym environment by name using make_mujoco_env with a config object
lookup_mujoco_spec: lookup a MujocoSpec by name using mujoco_env_by_name to get the env_id
build_mujoco_registry: build a MujocoSpec registry entry with a name and gym env_id for a new MuJoCo environment
review_mujoco_envs_list: review the MUJOCO_ENVS list to see which MuJoCo environments are registered
test_make_mujoco_env: test make_mujoco_env by creating a Hopper-v2 environment and verifying it returns a gym env
